title: gouldia antiqua
intro: Gouldia antiqua, commonly known as the Hawaiian silversword, is a rare and endangered plant species endemic to the Hawaiian Islands. This plant is known for its unique, silvery-gray foliage and vibrant yellow flowers. The health benefits of Gouldia antiqua include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being.
